instruction.text: Look at the underlined verb. Which tense is it in?

atoms.a: You <u>were playing</u> video games when she rang.
I <u>am choosing</u> what to wear to the party.
We <u>will be driving</u> for around 4 hours to get there.
The team <u>will be going</u> to celebrate after the match.
She <u>was sleeping</u> on the bus before we made it home.

instruction.text: Complete the sentences with the correct progressive tense form.

atoms.b: I will be watching a new TV show.
atoms.sound: Tomorrow night, I will be watching a new TV show.
Right now, I am walking to work.
When she rang the doorbell, I was washing the dishes.

instruction.text: Complete the sentences with the correct progressive tense form.

atoms.b: I will be swimming in the Mediterranean Sea.
atoms.sound: Next week, I will be swimming in the Mediterranean Sea.
At the moment, they are waiting for us.
